source_text.body:
Red-team and score student-housing underwriting deals
A poster uses Claude on a student-housing acquisition platform, with an agent that red-teams underwriting assumptions, scores deals on five dimensions, and gives a credit recommendation.
·
Mar 11, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
A commenter described a multi-agent pipeline inside Claude Projects for a student-housing acquisition platform. Deals move through separate agents for pre-screening, financial spreading from the OM, T-12, and rent roll, underwriting, and then a CCO agent that holds the credit policy, red-teams assumptions, scores five weighted dimensions, and can override with written justification; each deal stays in its own conversation, outputs are handed off in structured packages, and a human gate remains before anything goes to IC.
How it went
They said the CCO agent was the key change because it applied the same credit policy every time, and final reports auto-uploaded to Google Drive for partners. The reported result was cutting deal-receipt-to-scored-IC-memo time to under an hour on most submissions, but it was still not fully automated.
Worth knowing
The main catch was that they intentionally kept a human approval step before any deal went to investment committee.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Act as an investment committee skeptic on this student-housing deal. I'll paste the underwriting assumptions: [rents, occupancy, expenses, cap rate, financing, enrollment data]. Red-team each assumption, score the deal 1-10 on [five dimensions, e.g. market, location, sponsor, financials, risk], and give a final credit recommendation of approve, revise, or decline with reasons.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1r4sykz/underwriting_for_real_estate
